annotations.title: Which legal figure does my product need?

description: Searches REP27's product-category catalogue (toys, cosmetics, electronics, pet products, connected devices…) and returns, for the best matches, the EU legal figure required (responsible person, authorised representative, Art. 4 economic operator, GDPR representative) and the REP27 service.

lang.description: Language code for the answer (ISO 639-1, e.g. en, it, es, fr, de, pt, nl, pl, ja, zh)
lang.title: Lang

product.description: Product or product type to look up, in any language (e.g. wooden toys, lipstick, smart plug, dog food)
product.title: Product
